findings.detail: The peer advertises screen.v1 but not screen-echo.v1, so interactive sessions to it draw no local echo prediction: typed characters appear only after the host's echo arrives. The status line still works. (peer: host)
findings.remedy: Upgrade qsh on the peer to a build that advertises screen-echo.v1. Until then `--predict=auto` and `--predict=always` predict nothing; `--predict=always` prints one line to stderr saying so, and `--predict=never` is the same without the line.
